newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Housing and Development Bank proposing capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Housing and Development Bank proposing capital increase.

text.p: The board of Egypt's Housing and Development Bank is proposing offering to the public 2.4 million shares to increase the bank's paid-up capital by 24 million pounds ($7.07 million).
The bank said in an announcement published on Thursday it wanted to increase paid-up capital to 78 million pounds from the current 54 million. The bank has a total 900,000 shares.
The bank invited shareholders to vote on the proposal at an extraordinary general meeting which will be held on June 29.
